notes.f1: Tree adds I4 Hinrich, christened 29 Jul 1687 (S1, the hinted baptism), as a child of G8CJ-7VL and Liesbeth (R10, R11).
notes.f2: Liesbeth Oldenburg (GV6M-YN8) carries the name Elsch Burmeister sourced to the 1687 baptism: the alias reading.
notes.f3: ps_001 concludes the opposite: the 1687 son is G8CJ-7VL's and Elsch is Liesbeth, on a name variant and chronology. The 1690 Hinrich and Elsche baptism and the 1683 Liesebeth entry are never cited.
